valor.agora_en: erratum of management c1, in its own name (the section “The pre-registered Hubble-ratio test with the distance network (H0DN × BG1)”, sealed text of v410 that the v411 article carries unchanged): the section describes the state of v410, from 9 to 11 Nov 2026. Where it says “this version”, “in this version” and “today”, read v410. Where it says that no observed data are read, that um.py does not read that vector and that the opening belongs to a future version, read: so it was in v410; the future version is v411, in which the vector is embedded and the result is recomputed in the rite. Where it treats the vector outside the support as an assembly wall of the data, read instead: it is a property of the published error model (the management finding of 11 Nov and the amendment, D162); it is not an assembly error. Where it makes the opening conditional on a prior certification, blind, under the physical covariance, read: that condition was replaced on 11 Nov by the ratified design (D159), with the primary under the published error model and the 90% design-power gate; the certification did not exist and the opened test is not blind (reservations 1, 4 and 6). And where texts of earlier versions (the paragraph “What is not declared”, from v392, and the machine string of the record estatuto_da_prova_v391) say that β in nature at 5σ awaits instruments, the v411 note beside the statute of the proof holds. The sealed text is not rewritten; the erratum goes beside it.
